import csv,json,hashlib,re,html,subprocess,pathlib
r=pathlib.Path('.')
sources=json.loads((r/'docs/plans/boot-04-single-host-sources.json').read_text())
ok=[s for s in sources['retrievals'] if s['http_status']==200];bad=[s for s in sources['retrievals'] if s['http_status']!=200]
assert len(ok)==16 and len(bad)==1 and bad[0]['http_status']==404
texts={}
for s in ok:
 b=(r/'.local/boot-04-single-host-source-cache'/(s['id']+'.body')).read_bytes()
 assert len(b)==s['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==s['sha256']
 texts[s['id']]=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',html.unescape(re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',b.decode())))
rates=texts['hetzner-rate-update']
assert 'CCX23 0.0545 / 33.99 0.1402 / 87.49 0.0641 / 39.99 0.1650 / 102.99' in rates
assert 'CCX33 0.1042 / 64.99 0.2259 / 140.99 0.1234 / 76.99 0.2660 / 165.99' in rates
assert 'AX42-1 97.30 49.00 117.10 59.00' in rates
assert 'Cloud Primary IPv4 € 0.50 ($ 0.60) monthly' in texts['hetzner-ip']
assert 'Primary IPv4 € 1.70 € - $ 1.90 $ -' in texts['hetzner-ip']
assert re.search(r'Advance-3 2024 Starting at \$255',texts['ovh-advance-us'])
assert 'at-most-once' in texts['redis-pubsub'] and 'forever lost' in texts['redis-pubsub']
assert 'LISTEN' in texts['pgbouncer'] and 'transaction' in texts['pgbouncer'].lower()
assert 'dokploy-postgres' in texts['dokploy-control-backup']
assert 'S3' in texts['dokploy-database-backup']
assert 'cannot order dedicated root servers' in texts['hetzner-locations']
assert 'OVHcloud (Gravelines, France)' in texts['duels-privacy']
costs=json.loads((r/'docs/plans/boot-04-single-host-costs.json').read_text())
shared=costs['shared']['r2_storage'];assert shared['billable_gb']==shared['public_gb']+shared['private_backup_replay_gb']-shared['account_free_gb'];assert round(shared['billable_gb']*shared['usd_per_gb_month'],2)==shared['monthly_usd']
for c in costs['candidates']:
 assert round(c['host_monthly_usd']+(c['ipv4_monthly_usd'] or 0)+shared['monthly_usd'],2)==c['known_monthly_subtotal_usd']
 assert c['host_source_id'] in texts
assert len(costs['candidates'])==4 and len(costs['unpriced'])>=8
scope=json.loads((r/'docs/plans/boot-04-costs.json').read_text())['scope_source']
b=(r/'docs/vision/requirements.csv').read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==scope['sha256']
rows=list(csv.DictReader(b.decode().splitlines()));assert len(rows)==548 and len({x['group_id'] for x in rows})==33 and sum(x['optional']=='true' for x in rows)==20
old=list(csv.DictReader(subprocess.run(['git','show','HEAD:docs/vision/initial_backlog.csv'],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout.splitlines()))
new=list(csv.DictReader((r/'docs/vision/initial_backlog.csv').read_text().splitlines()));assert len(old)==len(new)==32
for a,z in zip(old,new):
 assert a['task_id']==z['task_id']
 if a['task_id']!='BOOT-04':assert a==z
 else:
  assert z['implementation_status']=='in_progress_single_host_proposal_director_decisions_open'
  assert all(a[k]==z[k] for k in a if k not in ['implementation_status','evidence_links'])
observed=json.loads((r/'docs/research/2026-10-08-duels-observations.json').read_text())
assert len(observed['coverage'])==14 and len(observed['delivered_sources']['assets'])==8
assert observed['network_summary']['socket']['frames_captured'] is False
assert observed['coverage'][-1]['cleanup']['game_ended'] is True
assert observed['director_report']['occurred_at'] is None
assert not re.search(r'eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\.[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\.',json.dumps(observed))
print('PASS16 source body hashes + expected404; current NA/EU/USD selectors; four cost sums/unknowns; Redis/pooler/backups/locations;548 requirements/33groups/20flags and32 preserved tasks; sanitized14-surface/eight-asset browser evidence limits.')
summary: Single-host research: cached source-byte integrity, actual quote selectors/arithmetic, unchanged vision/backlog and sanitized browser observation coverage; no runtime/provider capacity qualification
